notes.title: Hot Summer Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Fighters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/7c107a88a1118d0e2cddcc9ee5aa2ba6432388de.png

Hot Summer Update!

Summer’s heating up and so is SquadBlast! The new content update just dropped and it’s loaded. We’re talking 2 fresh maps, a higher level cap, more rewards to chase, fighter and weapon balance tweaks, and a whole lot more.

So grab your shades, stay hydrated, and let’s dive into everything coming your way:

New Maps

Crossroads - With this map, you're smack in the middle of a city skyline, with half-built towers, scaffolding everywhere, and cranes looming in the background to give you additional height advantage and great for surprise attacks!

Corndog - We’ve got it all on this farm, classic red barns, a silo, and wide open dirt paths ready for pandemonium. It gives you that peaceful countryside atmosphere, until you reach the open centre of the map greeted by narrow choke points and awkward slopes which only the best movement specialists can take full advantage of!

Level Cap Increased

The level cap has been raised by 10, allowing players to reach up to level 90! If your EXP was previously trimmed, you'll receive a special "Overachiever" avatar to showcase your dedication. And for the first player to hit level 90...something special awaits!

Gameplay Changes

- Armor regeneration rate has been increased to double its original rate
- Re-spawn time changed from 15 sec to 13 sec

Fighter Changes

- Laika’s COUNTERPART ability has been improved with Almerk’s Freeze-Tech module. Now when a clone is destroyed it will explode into a Freeze Cloud, encasing any would-be fighters who got easily fooled into a block of ice. Better watch out for those clones now!

- Hantu's SHADOW WALK got some serious ups now, while invisible, he can jump way higher than before. While invisible he also regenerates his health at a moderate rate. Perfect for pulling off those sneaky plays or surprise attacks from outta nowhere.

- Paavo’s GUARDIAN SHIELD gets additional armor while his shield’s up. And it’s not just for him! Anyone on the team chillin’ inside the shield gets that bonus too

- Sonny’s LITTLE HELPERS packin’ double trouble now, he can deploy two turrets preloaded instead of just one. That means more firepower, more map control, and way more headaches for the other team

- Arx’s EXO-SUIT rockets just got beefier and are now 50% bigger than before

Additionally, all fighters that used Roll to dodge have the speed increased by 25%, so you can zoom around like you’ve got places to be and bullets to dodge

Weapon Changes

Shotguns have been improved and re-balanced, hitting harder, cleaner and way more fun to use:

- NumbRNine can now stun enemies
- Frenzy now dishes out 2x more burning damage, so anyone you hit is gonna feel the heat
- Mule is more precise than ever with 50% less spread and 20% longer range
- Tyrant now has 10% lower spread, and 16.67% damage increase, easier to tackle against line-ups with big stacks

Bug Fixes

- Interact/PickUp button doesn’t get active for touch controls when you can’t actually interact with the object to pick up a weapon
- Mini-map fixes
- Bots can now use sprint, dash, and roll abilities
- Fixed a bug where experience was accumulating post the maximum level cap number, now once a player reaches max level, they will stop receiving experience from battle. In future patches, once max level is reached, the number will change to “Max Level” message
- Cover spot on the right side of Cable doesn't show once you're inside

Changes After PTS

Huge thanks to everyone who dropped feedback or reported bugs during the Summer PTS! Your input seriously helped us fine tune things. Here’s what we’ve tweaked since then:

- Corndog now has a slightly darker background to help chat become more visible
- Those barn doors on Corndog? Yep, they’re gone, to stop transition to different views
- If you’re tired of getting spawn trapped, that’s fine, we’ve added safe rooms at the top of the barn
- Raised the walls on both sides of Corndog to help you bounce around like a pro
- Nigel’s ability cooldown reduced from 15 to 11
- Sonny ability is going to be taking a nap and will be released in a future update
- Paavo bonus armor regeneration has been nerfed, reduced by 50%
- No more moon jumps from Hantu, ability reduced by 30%
- Frenzy’s fire effect damaged increased by 20%
- Hellsing damage increased by 14%
- Laser gate hitboxes on the right side of Cable has been fixed
- Rocket Launcher knockback force increased, damage received from your own rocket decreased down to 50%
- You can now be sneaky in the cover spots on Cable. No more peeking them on the minimap or seeing stray limbs

Alright, that’s a wrap on this content drop! From fresh maps to fighter changes and weapon tweaks, we’re leveling up the chaos just in time for summer. You bring the skills, we’ll bring the content. Also thanks for all your feedback as always, and we’ll be watching as we continue to prepare more updates (and surprises too!)

P.S. Don’t forget the sunscreen. It won’t save you from rockets, but it might save your K/D from sweat.

notes.title: Update 0.9.15.0: October 28th, 2024
notes.notes:
Hey Fighters!

It’s been a hot minute since we released our previous update. But the team have been hard at work to bring you an upgrade to SquadBlast across all platforms, increased level caps, armor changes and a brand new weapon!

Let’s check out what’s coming up:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/2a8c8c9f8f14bb93fe39148fe3ce42d1cf92ef1c.png

Booster Update!

SquadBlast just got a solid upgrade, and it’s gonna run smoother on all platforms. If you notice any issues or glitches, feel free to give us a shout on our community Discord and we’ll check them out right away!

New Level Cap and Fighter Progressions

Things are heating up on the Leaderboards as everyone’s chasing more Valor and XP. With some players already pushing the limits, we’re adding new levels and rewards. Account Progression now goes up to level 80, and Fighter Masteries up to level 20!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/4577639bebe1b704da5ebe55bbfbc453938bf98c.png

New Weapon - Tumbleweed

Say hello to your new secondary weapon: a grenade launcher that fires sticky grenades! These babies stick to all surfaces, even your enemies! Use them to mess with opponents, block paths, or get creative with your plays!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/700deba1599b2342a6d2ed0b17d1c211d4913bcd.gif

Gameplay Changes

We’re tweaking the armor system because it ended up being a tad OP. Now with the new Armor Restoration system, the regen speed has slowed down by 75%, and it only kicks in after you’ve been out of the fight for 10 seconds.

Other Changes

- Two exclusive frames added & distributed to Season 9 duelists
- Performance and stability improvements
- SquadBlast now available on Discord Apps
- SquadBlast now available on Ray Browser, and a new exclusive Ray skin was introduced and distributed on our Discord server

notes.title: Update: 0.9.14.0: August 8th, 2024
notes.notes:
Hey Fighters!

You're all in for a treat with this update! It's jam packed with new additions, including a new map, a new game mode, a handy new grenade to help in those dire situations and other changes to which we’ll get stuck into shortly!

Let’s take a look at what’s to come:

New Game Mode - Touchdown

In this action-packed game mode, teams compete to grab the ball and score by getting it to the enemy gates! To score points, you must take the ball into the opposing team's goal. But watch out! The ball holder moves slower and has less stamina, so quick reflexes and smart teamwork are the name of the game!

- Pass the ball to your teammates, but watch out for any enemies hanging around!
- You can’t use your weapons while you’ve got the ball, so teamwork is key!
- To score, just carry the ball into the goal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/0aaf7ce8726ce7e85ccfafdb0ab1ba62b5db6165.gif

New Map - Cosmopolis

We can’t have a new game mode without a new map, right? Of course not! Say hello to Cosmopolis, our latest addition to the map pool!

Cosmopolis has a symmetrical layout which will involve a fair amount of close range combat engagements and plenty of opportunities to use the map's geometry for speed and momentum!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/78d24dd8943fbda8a83d3e54238a082563d5c9db.png

New Weapon - Patchdoc

The new healing grenade known as the Patchdoc was teased in the past, but now available to bag!

It creates a healing explosion when it lands, giving everyone in the blast radius an instant health boost and ongoing regeneration.

You can grab the Patchdoc from Blueprints in the crafting menu or by opening weapon parcels and crates. Here are the drop chances:

- Weapon Parcel: Base [0.4%]
- Weapon Case: Base [1.4%] Classic [1.4%]
- Random Weapon Blueprint: [0.35%]
- Sidearm Blueprint: Base [6.5%] Classic [0.32%]
- Champion Weapon Blueprint: Classic [0.87%]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/9bc65c8c9010f3ab97238b2af1a2882e04f5e35c.png

Gameplay Changes

Weapon crates will now randomly drop at each team’s spawn grid. Inside, you’ll find weapons ranging from regular to ultimate. To see what’s inside, just punch the box really hard. Or, you know, shoot it. Both work!

Game Servers & Languages

We've got some fantastic news to share as our game servers are now live and kicking across the globe! That means more players, more fun, all platforms and with our optimized servers, you can say goodbye to lag and hello to seamless gameplay! 

SquadBlast is also available in most countries worldwide, and to celebrate, we've added support for 10+ more languages. This means SquadBlast is now localized into your own language! If you want to revert back to English, simply go to Settings > Languages and select English.

We're expanding our global coverage by adding the following languages:

- Portuguese
- Portuguese Brazil
- Spanish Mexican
- Turkish
- Polish
- Japanese (available on Web and Android devices soon)
- Korean (available on Web and Android devices soon)
- Vietnamese
- Fillipines
- Thai (available on Web and Android devices soon)
- Indonesian

There might be some translation quirks. If you spot any, please report them on discord! Your efforts help make the game better for everyone, and as a thank you, you'll be awarded 200 Bitchips for your hard work!

UI Changes

- Various fixes for texts throughout the game
- Separate tabs in the Shop for G-Cash and BitChips

Other Changes

- Gumball assault rifle has its traits back

As a heads up, replays and spectating custom matches will be unavailable for some time as they’ll be reworked. You’ll see these features return in a future update.

notes.title: Update: 0.9.12.0: April 22nd, 2024
notes.notes:
Hey Fighters!

We've packed quite a punch in our latest update which will continue to help improve everyone’s experience on SquadBlast! Including the long awaited re-join feature, additional progression levels, a blinding new secondary weapon and something to tease you in the fighter selection!

Let’s have a gander at what’s coming up:

Quick-Join

That feature we've all been itching for in matchmaking and custom battles is finally here - the ability to jump into battles mid-match!

Now, if there's not enough players to kick off a new battle from the Main Menu, you can hop right into an ongoing match and make your mark.

In Custom Games, you can fire up a battle pronto and add players to your lobby on the fly. Fill up all 6 or 10 slots during the brawl, swap out bots, and dive straight into the next game with a full squad.

This tech unlocks a whole bunch of possibilities we're excited to explore down the road, like match-carry-over, multi-level matches, and other great ways to roll with your squad.

Air Resistance

With the new addition to the SquadBlast movement mechanics, air resistance will slow you down as you move at breakneck velocity speeds, adding a layer of challenge to your manoeuvres. It means you can't repeatedly slide-jump your way through everything anymore. Instead, you'll need real skill, combining different techniques to keep up your speed. 

Stamina becomes crucial for maintaining momentum. This tweak might make gameplay a bit slower, which could be a relief for new players and newbies alike, who find it hard to keep up. It also makes players easier targets, so taking cover and using weapons wisely becomes more important. You can still pull off old tricks, but now you actually have to put in some effort to master them.

Progression

We've added a whopping 20 new main account progression levels, featuring two unique new frames to show your dedication and a lot more rewards. 

From now on, once you hit the max level, that's it, no more leveling up. Before, you could keep piling up experience points, but now, once you're at the top, you're at the top. And to make it clear, we're gonna slap a big ol' "Max Level" label on the screen when you reach the current cap.

Weapons

Introducing a brand new grenade to the SquadBlast arsenal, the Dazzler! 

Based on an old SunSpark stun grenade, this new and improved variant by Zhang packs a punch that leaves your enemies disoriented and confused for a short period. 

As always, the Dazzler is available in sidearms crafting only and will be added to weapon cases in future updates.

Warning: Don't stare directly at the explosion!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/2fdb89c6a85f86a7c8fe89f2027137db447b742d.gif

UI Changes

- Changes in custom lobbies to support new quick-join feature.

Other Changes

- A certain new character has made an appearance in the loadout, albeit in unavailable state. Share your expectations and ideas on discord!

Bug Fixes

- Fixed UI animations for buttons on mobile


Update: April 30th 2024

We've listened to all your feedback about air resistance, and we get that it's not everyone's cup of tea. So, we've rolled out an update that completely removes air resistance. Now you can get back to enjoying SquadBlast just the way you like it – fast-paced, adrenaline-pumping action with no holds barred!

Thanks to everyone who helped test these changes during the PTS and previous update. And rest assured, we're already eyeing up more improvements for the future.

notes.title: Update: 0.9.11.0: March 12th, 2024
notes.notes:
Hey Fighters!

We've got it all in our upcoming update. The workshop is now available, introducing a new currency, a brand-new weapon, and the highly anticipated big balance patch. Plus, we're throwing in a speedrun challenge to help improve your movement combos, or just for some good old banter. Without further ado, let's get straight into the details:

Workshop

The Workshop is now live! You can finally put those spare components which you previously dismantled to good use!

Say goodbye to those duplicate weapons and fashion items cluttering your inventory! With our latest update, you can now dismantle them to create scrapped gun parts and synth threads, which you can use for crafting various blueprints (Note: Currently, only weapon crafting is available; fashion crafting is on its way in a future update).

Each blueprint has different crafting material costs and offers a list of potential items you can gain. Keep an eye out for “tokens,” a rare craft component that has a higher chance of dropping when you dismantle a classic version of a weapon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/a7b57d9406909b82c82939ce996049633587a50e.jpg

Looking for a budget-friendly option? The “???” blueprint is the cheapest and gives you a random weapon from any category. We’ll be curious to see who gets lucky!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/401ff1605a9c142e0a796af86761e2c82ce04b89.jpg

Crafting can reward you with weapons from your account progression, or you can craft unique weapons that won’t be found in weapon parcels. Speaking of parcels, they can drop either an account progression weapon or a unique one specific to parcels.

Select a weapon blueprint, mix in some components, and there you have it! Your new weapon is ready for action. Try any blueprint for a surprise creation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/840f052e8e4da0eb221d9fa9858d5b597cc35021.jpg

New Currency & Rewards Rework

You can now claim a new type of currency from your battles known as “G-Cash.” You can collect G-Cash by grinding out your matches, but you can only collect a certain amount of G-Cash per day. More can be purchased by heading over to our shop.

We’ve also revamped rewards after your battles have concluded! Not only will you gain Valor, Exp and Hero Exp, but parcels drop rate have increased, you can bag some G-Cash and even a shot at keys and crafting materials!

The leaderboard rewards for the upcoming season will also be a tad different. Stay tuned as we reveal the details closer to the next season.

New Weapon - Radzone

We've got another weapon to add to your arsenal, the Radzone Sniper Rifle! Shoot your target, and they'll be taking damage for 4 seconds with the radioactive effect. Anyone else stepping into the radioactive zone around your fighter will catch the bug too. If the players are not attentive, they can easily wipe out their own team!

If you want to grab the Radzone, you’ll need to craft the weapon in the Workshop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/21412b8ed8266e550d0270fd254f5be0b2e70776.gif

The Great Rebalance

We've been reading through your comments, analyzing match stats, and running internal playtests for the past few weeks. The goal? Tackle the game balance issues to enhance your overall SquadBlast experience. This update brings a slew of changes to weapons, effects, heroes, abilities, and yes, even a touch of mod magic!

You’ll need your spectacles for this one, as it’s quite a hefty list, but the changes will be very beneficial for the integrity of SquadBlast:

Weapons

First of all - damage and individual gun effects:

- Kewler explosion damage 55 -> 35
- Dynonova clip size 5 -> 1
- Dynonova start ammo 5 -> 3
- Dynonova projectile damage 40 -> 65
- NumbRNine Damage 12 -> 13
- Haymaker Damage 12 -> 8
- Mule Damage 20 -> 18
- Artemis Damage 110 -> 95
- Swamphog Damage 70 -> 60
- Avalanche Damage 30 -> 45, 25 -> 35, 20 -> 30
- Gumball Damage 12 -> 10
- Gattling Damage 18 -> 20
- Lenus Damage 66 -> 60, Lifesteal 33% -> 50%
- Kriegwerk Damage 35 -> 45
- Bullfrog Damage 80 -> 60

Then, overall and elemental effects:

- Weapon reload time and Time between shots per stack of Shock effect 10% -> 8%
- Jump height reduction per stack of Slime effect 10% -> 7%

Hero changes

The biggest list is adjustments to hero parameters:

- Hantu Max Armor 120 -> 100, Max HP 180 -> 100, Move Speed 1.2 -> 1.1, Max Stamina 100 -> 200, Stamina regen 15 -> 30 per second;
- Dash Max Armor 120 -> 100, Max HP 180 -> 100, Move Speed 1 (unchanged), Max Stamina 100 -> 150, Stamina regen 15 -> 25 per second;
- Arx Max Armor 60 -> 100, Max HP 150 -> 100, Move Speed 1 -> 0.97, Max Stamina 100 -> 150, Stamina regen 15 -> 20 per second;
- Nigel Max Armor 120 -> 100, Max HP 150 -> 100, Move Speed 1.15 -> 0.97, Max Stamina 100 -> 150, Stamina regen 15 -> 20 per second;
- Sonny Max Armor 50 -> 100, Max HP 200 -> 125, Move Speed 0.93 -> 0.9, Max Stamina 100 -> 120;
- Paavo Max Armor 80 -> 100, Max HP 250 -> 150, Move Speed 0.9 (unchanged), Max Stamina remains 60, Stamina regen remains 10 per second;
- Laika Max Armor 70 -> 100, Max HP 150 -> 100, Move Speed 0.95 -> 0.93, Max Stamina remains 100, Stamina regen remains 15 per second.

Some of the abilities have changes as well:

- Nigel HealBeam ability can heal himself if there are no wounded allies nearby
- Nigel HealBeam ability power reduced by 50% (40 hp per second -> 20 hp per second)
- Paavo shield ability cooldown reduced 20 -> 12

And the last, but not least we’ve made changes on how armor works:

- All Fighters will now have 100 Max Armor by default;
- Armor no longer reduces incoming damage by 20%;
- Armor will regenerate during 5 seconds when Fighter didn't shoot, deal or receive damage in the last 5 seconds;
- Big Armor pickups will increase max Armor by 20 (stacks up to 3 times) and regenerate all current Armor;
- Increased Armor effect will disappear on death;

While not being a change related to weapons or heroes directly, there is one more important thing that’s different to complement everything above - respawn time. For all maps and most modes, it is now consistent at 15 seconds instead of variable timers before. Team deathmatch game mode will feature 8 seconds respawn time to support dynamic flow!

SpeedRun Challenge Preview

A while back, some folks in our discord pondered if it was possible to speedrun SquadBlast. Our level artists spent some time and got a pretty quick prototype that is sort of similar to Sliding challenges known in the speedrun communities (You may even seen a preview in our discord a few weeks back). In this update, we are making the SpeedRun Challenge preview available in Custom Games for all. 

The preview mode currently lacks automation and leaderboards, so the only way to share your high scores for now will be either by checking the replay section or posting screenshots of your reward screens in a newly created discord channel.

We’re looking at the community to give us feedback on this, if this is something you think we should do more of or add a proper coat of paint.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/c592f6c0b2346fb5fccf0450171e9d6164eacae3.png

Sound improvements

- Improved special positioning of sounds in battle
- New character shoutouts in battles and more action sounds
- New sound effects for black holes, gravity and poison barrels
- New music in the Main menu, bringing in more upbeat and energy

UI Changes

- Hero tooltips now show current Mastery level progress
- When you browse the menus, scroll positions will be reset if you went to a different tab or menu and returned back
- The weapon inspection screen is updated, so you can now see how your hero looks with the gun in his hands, but you still can open a full screen weapon preview and check out all the small details
- There is now a dedicated language selection screen available from the “Pause Menu” while you are not in battle
- Inactive buttons are hidden from quest tooltips
- For Payload Extraction mode there are new and updated hints and announcements to provide more clarity on the current situation
- Destructible objects in battle like boxes now have health bars
- New artworks in game launch screen

Bug Fixes

- In CTF mode when F.L.A.G is stolen and then returned by a member of you team, it respawns immediately
- While in Payload Extraction mode defenders can’t get points from staying on the payload anymore
- Various fixes for how player profile pictures and frames are shown in the game - they now will update properly and instantly when changed, plus there shouldn't be any situations where they are not visible
- Replays filtering and search as well as Mission History in player profile are fixed and now show proper lists of played games to examine
- You will now see a green dot notification when new profile customization options are unlocked like new frames or profile pictures
- Fixed slow cursor with default speed on low-res screens including Steam Deck
- Various issues fixed with players getting stuck or reconnecting

March 20th Update:

We heard that some of you had trouble claiming your Quests, and we're really sorry about that. But hey, the good news is, we've sorted it out. You can now complete and claim your quests like normal.

As a big thank you for sticking with us through this hiccup, we're giving everyone in the community some compensation. You'll get parcels, plus weapon and fashion lockpicks based on how many matches you played each day. Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Update: 0.9.10.5: February 13th, 2024
notes.notes:
Hey Fighters!

Mobile tweaks and translations will be the talk of the town in today’s minor update! Let’s take a quick look at what’s coming up:

Mobile UI Improvements

We've spruced up the interface to make your lives easier navigating the menus:

- Enlarged buttons for navigation and accessing specific actions at the bottom of the screen
- Swapped out the gear cog icon for a new menu button, that opens menu from every screen where it’s present now

notes.title: Update 0.9.10.0: December 22nd, 2023
notes.notes:
Ho Ho Ho Fighters!

In all it’s glory, we’ll be bringing you some festive cheer with our new Frosty Fest event, Payload Extraction, seasonal leaderboards, profile customization and 2 new weapons hitting the shelves to dabble with!

Let’s have a gander in more detail at what’s coming up:

Frosty Fest Event

It’s holiday time! We're unwrapping some tasty treats for SquadBlast with our first game event - FrostyFest!

'Tis the season of goodies in SquadBlast! Join in the fun over the next few weeks until the end of January, collect special candies in your regular matches, and splash out on cool stuff from our new special Shop Section. Keep an eye out for the special FrostyFest Case in your battle drops – it's loaded with both weapon and fashion items. Don't miss the festive treats!

We've sprinkled a bit of holiday magic around your favourite locations in SquadBlast. Can you spot all the festive decorations?

Don't forget to check www.squadblast.com every day for the next 7 days, pop open the Frosty Fest Advent Calendar, and scoop up those daily rewards!

Maps and modes

New Mode - Payload Extraction

What's better than one Payload mode? You got it – two! Introducing the latest addition to our mode lineup – Payload Extraction. It's like a classic concept with a shiny new twist.

In a nutshell: Two rounds, one goal! Attackers need to haul the payload across the map to the extraction point while defenders attempt to stop 'em. Round two? Teams swap sides, and victory goes to whoever gets that payload moving faster or closer to the extraction point.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/d888c6874c213c71528a04338fede1167e15cd39.gif

New map - Brooklyn Rush

The first mission available to participate in the update takes place not that far from the New York’s Hideouts - just across the river in Brooklyn with views of the iconic bridge. There is something very attractive about this city.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/18b1ff7a06fc41adaf25359016ebb48b2a987903.jpg

Changes to Matchmaking

We've tweaked the matchmaking rules. Now, when you hit that Battle button, all maps for all modes are 3v3, except for the first match on the Underfoot map. Plus, the party size limit has shrunk to 3 players. so get your trio stacks ready!

Seasons & Leaderboards

We've been cooking up some changes, and now it's time to say hello to Seasonal Leaderboards in SquadBlast!

We hit the reset button on the Leaderboards, and now we've placed them into seasons! Every few weeks, we're shaking up the schedule, resetting the scores, and dishing out rewards like candy based on where you're positioned.

The Leaderboards itself has undergone a facelift. Now, your rewards are clearly displayed on the right side. So you always know what's up for grabs. And the icing on the cake? A snazzy timer to keep you posted on when the season's wrapping up. Plus, information in the archives, check out past seasons, and discover the legends and their epic weapons.

The current Season 1 will continue for a little while after the release of the update, and Season 2 will start soon!

Profile customization

Picture this – you're cruising the new Leaderboards, and those default player icons are a bit meh. Not cool, right? Well now you can pimp your profile with the first batch of vanity items – Profile Pictures and Frames.

You can unlock new swag from Hero Masteries, pick from a bunch of awesome base options, and level up in the game to unlock even more. We've got some special seasonal ones dropping real soon!

Oh, and to make life easier, every profile picture and frame comes with a little note telling you where to grab them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/2d635d1d591b6906bfaf06e708f3c1b1982424a5.jpg

It's here to sprinkle some elemental mayhem and give newcomers a taste of what's coming their way. Slow down your opponents, stick 'em to the ground, and seize that advantage!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/c70f54612b0c8fe7f3e4f7ad2117342b1008ccb1.gif

This secondary smoke grenade launcher deploys a smokescreen, decreasing visibility, concealing your exact location, whilst turning the map into a tactical playground.

The labyrinth can be a game changer for setting up battles which can work in your favour by creating sneaky plays in both slaying power and objective efficiency.

Visgoo’s effect is applied on hit by a grenade explosion. This means you must be aware of it even if this toy is in your ally’s hands. Or even in yours!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.9.4.0 - July 7th, 2023
notes.notes:
Wassup Fighters! 

We've already made major changes to the Grenade Launchers, and now we're taking things up a notch with adjustments to the Avalanche and Bullseye Rocket Launchers and a redesigned Tugarin! Don’t worry, we have plenty more for you to dig through! So, without delaying things any further, let’s take a peek at what’s in-store!

Weapon Updates

This week, we've gone all-in on the Avalanche and Bullseye Rocket Launchers. We've given them some killer redesigns, cool adjustments and necessary tweaks.

Avalanche 

It was completely redesigned to give players a Rocket Launcher that has some crowd control ability with some cool themes while keeping the gun easy to learn, and hard to master.

- Projectiles split into 2 smaller ones after 12.5 meters. The secondary and tertiary projectiles deal the same damage but have considerably smaller explosion radiuses.
- AoE radius: 5m, 3m, 2m respectively
- Also gained a frost theme to match better with its name meaning that explosions apply freezing.
- Freezing effect: 50%, 40% 30% respectively
- Damage for all rockets is 40. This means that ideally you keep your distance when engaging to cause maximum damage.

Bullseye

We've made some changes to the Bullseye to give you a pro-level experience. It's all about hitting hard and showing off your advanced aiming skills and mechanical proficiency.

- Scoped rocket launcher: To make it more than a gimmick the weapon has a low range (compared to a rocket launcher) when unscoped (25 meters). Scoping increases the range of the projectile by 50%.
- *Pro tip: The range is determined when the weapon shoots so you can stop scoping in the moment you launched the rocket meaning you can with some practice get around the movement penalties.*
- It received a milder scope compared to sniper rifles (only 70% move speed and jump reduction, less camera offset, less zoom out).
- The projectile is fast and accurate and hits really hard (125 damage, by far the highest amongst rocket launchers), but it has a 2-meter explosion radius so it is almost a single target weapon (Though if the enemy does you a favor by grouping up tightly, you can make them pay for it).

Tugarin Replacement

The Tugarin weapon has now been replaced with the new Boato! The very Pistola Olivary redesign for this assault rifle has finally arrived.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/05aa03d1927ade6236d45b214caf33ed554bac95.png

Game Center support for iOS devices

Great news for iOS users! We've added a new login option just for you. Now, you can log in using the Apple Game Center. If you're already logged in with your Apple ID account, it'll seamlessly link to your SquadBlast profile. Even if you reinstall the app or switch devices, your progress will be automatically restored. It's hassle-free gaming at its finest!

UI Changes

- In the Replays tab in Social section Match ID is now visible and you can search for replays using IDs now.
- Long-awaited friend list update! Please welcome its brand new fresh look and new Recent Players sections. Played with a cool teammate, but forgot his name? No need to worry about that now. Open your friend list with the button in the bottom panel and check out the recent players’ list. You can send them friend request of them to your party with a single action!
Also, we’ve added players’ search to the top of the friend list too. It looks like finding new friends and teammates became easier now!
- Public and Private party changes. We heard your feedback that party creation had too many steps and was not clear. While working on the major changes here, we made several adjustments to improve your party experience. 
Find Public party button on the main screen will join you to the existing public party or will create a new one for you by default. 
If you want to play with your friends, you can invite them to your party by opening a Friend List and clicking on the “+” button here. This action will create a private party with your friend, but you can still press ‘Start Searching’ if you wish to look for missing teammates in global Squadblast community. 
We’ve also added tooltips for these buttons to make sure you will get used to the Public/Private party differences in no time.
- New hero animations in the Main Menu for Arx and Sonny.


Other Changes

Improved reconnections handling. In cases when your internet connection changes or is not stable, there will be fewer issues with the game reconnecting back fast

Bug Fixes

Scrolling in the Match History tab in the player profile now correctly resets when you go between several players. Sorting starts with the latest matches at the top and goes to the older ones at the bottom properly.


We'll be back before you know it with more updates. We value your feedback, so keep those awesome ideas coming. We're excited to catch up with you soon and make SquadBlast even better together. Keep on gaming and see you in the next update!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.9.0 - March 27th, 2023
notes.notes:
Hey, Fighters! 🛠️ UPDATE 0.9.0 IS LIVE!🛠️ 

Buckle up because we’ve got an exciting update for you that's gonna shake things up. We've worked hard to fine-tune the balance and synergy of our Fighter crew, and we're also giving you a sneak peek of a brand new map. And that's not all! Finally we’re spicing up the game play with BARRELS! So get your game faces on, let’s do this!

👷 ARX REWORK

Arx got a major upgrade! His go-to weapon now is Assault Rifles instead of Rocket Launchers. His abilities and stats have been overhauled to make him faster, stronger, and more resilient. The Mecha-suit he wears now has a higher HP and can move faster, but the damage caused by its projectiles has been toned down. Ability duration has been increased and Xavier now packs a 30% stun effect with more powerful knockback from Siegebreaker shots. However, there's a downside to his new robot form as it can catch fire or freeze.

Arx changes:

- Weapon family was changed from Rocket Launchers to Assault Rifles.
- Movement speed was increased from 0.95 to 1.10 (slightly below Nigel which is 1.15 and Hantu 1.2).
- Max Armor was increased from 50 to 80.
- Max HP was increased from 150 to 180.

Xavier Mecha-suit changes:

- HP increased from 300 to 400.
- Projectile damage was decreased from 18 to 7.
- Added slow effect on hit of the Xavier projectile (-50% movement speed).
- Added 30% stun effect on hit (4 hits required to stun a target for 0.65 seconds).
- Ability Duration increased from 8sec to 10sec.
- Speed increased by 30%.
- Increased KnockBack from Siegebreaker shots from 25 to 150.
- While piloting Xavier Arx is now susceptible to catching fire and being frozen.

So basically, we felt like Arx needed a makeover because he wasn't cutting it as a hero, both in and outside of his exo-suit. Also, we want Assault Rifles to be more of a viable option when you're playing the game.

We're currently trying out Arx's fresh new formula and seeing how it goes. We're open to hearing what the community thinks about it, so feel free to share your feedback with us. We want to make sure this change is a good fit for everyone.

🔗 ACCOUNT LINKING BETWEEN PLATFORMS

Guess what? You can now play SquadBlast on multiple devices using just one account! It's super easy too. No more hassle of juggling multiple accounts. All you gotta do is go to the Settings menu and link your profile with your iPad, or your Android device for some home playtime. You can even mix and match devices however you want! Best of all, you can use the same account on all the different platforms out there - Steam, Apple AppStore on iOS and Google Play on Android.

IMPORTANT: It’s not possible to disconnect the devices. Also, players should be careful with their account codes and avoid sharing them with others. 

🗺️ NEW BETA MAP

You can now try the new map with codename "Serpentine." It's a super early beta version of a potentially new location and environment for King of the Hill mode in Custom lobbies. This sweet spot is located in the stormy Sea of Cortez down south of California, where an undersea Lithium mining platform has been fiercely fought over by various cartels for a while now. And get this, something crazy just happened! A sudden occurrence of Erythrium has put UltraHorse interests right smack in the middle of all this chaos.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/3105711b52986f547d0903d5866e3af87d560a62.jpg

💢 BATTLE MODIFIERS

We just updated our battle system and added a new twist to it! Now battles can have some special conditions applied to them. We've introduced the first-ever environmental hazard - barrels! So, during matchmaking, you might come across a map with barrels spawning all over the battlefield. And here's the fun part: there are two types of barrels - exploding and freezing! You can use them to your advantage by either shooting from a distance or punching them towards your enemies. It's totally up to you! So, get ready to bring on some explosive action and freeze out your opponents!

Once you hit level 5, you might start seeing some barrels popping up here and there. But as you keep going, get ready to run into those suckers more frequently. And make sure you keep an eye out for a sign!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/45231478791feab42c7004b13ea2879b81909f8f.png

You can't use modifiers yet in Custom Lobbies. They'll be available in one of the upcoming updates, so stay tuned.

🔫 WEAPON AND BALANCE CHANGES

- The beast mode doesn’t restore your armor and health on pick up.
- For weapons we’ve updated the Traits section to focus on what makes each gun unique and why you may want to play with it. No more Compared to RL-88 there.
- Numb-R-Nine projectile damage was decreased by 25% (20 → 15).

🖥️ USER INTERFACE CHANGES

- We have made further visual improvements to the Account and Mastery progression screens. Additionally, we have updated the progress bar so that points must reach the next level in order to unlock it, allowing you to claim your reward and displaying your progress within the current level.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/ddea41b62bb96670a0d7fed45c324e3b120c4060.jpg
   
- You can now inspect you hats without wearing them.
- New indication with huge red cross when you do eliminations in battle.
- Quest reward tooltips now have a text description of a reward in addition to the icon.
- Match ID is shown for replays same way as for actual matches on Scoreboard and in Post-battle.

🔷 OTHER CHANGES

- There are two new platforms added to the Underfoot map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660749/0ba47190a090599dbd49fa13b022307ef3d85c13.jpg

- Improved Arx Robot form behavior on platform edges and during wall sliding.
- Improved anti-toxicity chat moderation.
- Good news for those of you using custom bindings - pressing menu-related bindings (such as B/Circle on a controller to exit Settings or A/Cross to Respawn) won't trigger custom actions in-match anymore.
- We have updated the distribution of Valor and Mastery points, as well as the requirements to reach new levels. With this update, you will keep the level you reached in the previous version, as well as the percentage of progress towards the next level. However, the amount of Valor or Mastery required to reach it has changed.
- There is now a bigger starting roster of heroes, consisting of five characters: Arx, Hantu, Paavo, Sonny, and Nigel. The last two were previously locked from the start and only available through account progression.

🐞 BUG FIXES

- Fixed animations for multiple jumps between walls.
- Fixed claiming Quest rewards while in Party.
- Removed wrong information about Bullfrog and carrying objectives.
- Fixed blank pictures for King of the Hill maps in Mission History replay list in Player’s Profile.
- Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.7.2 - October 28, 2022
notes.notes:
🛠️ UPDATE 0.7.2 IS LIVE!🛠️ 

Good news, Fighters! 

Today we have a lot of changes. You'd better have a cup of tea🍵  and put a cat🐈  on your knees if you have pet-keeping permission for your UltraHorse Towers apartment before you start reading. No tea and no cat? You should have a water bottle to stay hydrated, at least! 😁 

In this update, we improved some essential pillars of your SquadBlast experience - matchmaking, progression, and guns. As I mentioned in yesterday's announcement, we had to reset your profile progress to accommodate these changes. 
BUT the good thing is that all of the bonus items you received from promo codes are safe! 

🔸[NEW] LOADOUT SETS

You can now create more than one weapon set for every hero in your Loadout and switch primary and secondary weapons instantly during the fight on Respawn screen.

🔸[NEW] WEAPON EDITIONS

There were only base and common guns with default appearances in the game for a while. Now your favorite guns are available in new editions. Play the game, achieve new levels, and get new colorful rewards.
At last, Laika can stop pestering the UH weapons master Ziggy for custom hardware decorations. "Default grey sucks butt." she claims.

🔸[NEW] GUNPEDIA
All the weapons you can get in the game are now presented in our Database within the Gunpedia section. Check out the guns you have, weapons you saw in battles, and get a glimpse of what's available for you to unlock!

🔸[NEW] WEAPON CASES

When in battle, you will, from time to time, receive case rewards. They are unlocked automatically after the battle, and you will see a new gun you received from the chest.

🔸[NEW] INSPECTION

All your guns can now be inspected with the details, stats, and traits with the new look of the Inspection view available from Loadout, Inventory, and Gunpedia.

🔸[NEW] PRACTICE ROOM
Try out new weapons or sets, or combos whenever you want instantly directly from the Loadout menu. On the special map, you can check out how every weapon you have works, its spread, how your enemies react to it and practice your skills without any pressure of a real fight. 
Hantu is pissed about the new testing order. "It was just fine when we tested out in the hangar—no idea why the maintenance guys were bent. None of them got hit. If you ask me, I'd say a few stray bullets here and there kept everyone alert."

🔸[NEW] ASSAULT RIFLE - LOGI
There is now a new AR with explosive projectiles. This assault weapon fires explosive bullets that cause more damage than conventional projectiles. Expensive gear was developed for private corporation guard forces to put the fear of god into annoying gatherings of citizen rabble.

🔸[NEW] DISCORD ACTIVITY & SHARING
Discord app can now show your in-game activity, whether you browse menus or participate in a match. And if you want to share your custom lobby, you can do it directly via Discord app using the + button. 

🔹[UPDATE] Character & Account Progression
We've updated how progression systems work in the game. After every match, you now receive a certain amount of Valor, which goes into your account progression. At the same time, all heroes you played during the match now receive a corresponding amount of Mastery Points based on their results on the battlefield.

🔹[UPDATE] Matchmaking System
We introduced an improved matchmaking rating system to make battles fairer and match you with opponents of the same skill levels. Be aware that it will take a few games to calibrate your profile.

🔹[UPDATE] Battle Experience for new players
All players start the game with four predefined maps sequence. You can play them with bots or be matchmade with other newcomers who just started exploring SquadBlast. Go through Underfoot in Conquest, Moonshine Run Payload, Muertigo TDM, and Hakone Conquest to start your fight and jump into open matchmaking next.

🔹QOL IMPROVEMENTS:

  Added sorting and various filters to weapon inventory. 
  We've added proper UI icons to support DualShock 4 and DualSense gamepads.
  The main screen visual has been updated.
  Melee weapons now have proper names in the battle HUD.


⚖️ BALANCE CHANGES:
The Mule shotgun has been rebalanced:
 
 Range increased from 13 to 16m
 Fire rate increased from 0.83/sec to 1.25/sec
 Magazine capacity increased from 5 to 6
 Overall ammo stash capacity increased from 15 to 24
 Damage/projectile decreased from 25 to 20
 Spread was reduced by about 10%
 Self-knockback force was reduced significantly.


More gun changes:

 The Zeus chain effect now only targets other players and not environmental objects like the Payload.
 Scorpio damage has been increased from 15 to 16.
 The first extreme measures bonus is now given after the 3rd death instead of the 4th.
 Sonny's turret will now properly shoot Laika's clones if they're in shooting range.
 The Impact 69 shotgun hand positioning has been fixed. 


🐞 BUGFIXES:

 There has been a Bullfrog projectiles explosion fix. It's now more consistent. The secondary projectiles now explode one frame after the initial explosion. Before, secondary projectiles could still have an additional 40 meters range.
 We have updated the description for Zeus about the chain effect and the Trident about its smaller explosion radius.
 Action hints in battle have been fixed and now show proper buttons, including the ones to press and hold on gamepads.
 Chat messages timestamps now show the time of your local time zone.
 System Messages are not 12:00 all the time anymore.

🛠️ UPDATE 0.7.0 IS LIVE! 🛠️ 

Attention, Fighters! 

This one contains some changes to the battle flow, QoL improvements, and bugfixes. 
And next week, we will release another one focused on the new content for higher mastery levels. Make sure you achieved its maximum this week to unlock new guns earlier! 

🔸 [NEW] BATTLE SYSTEM - EXTREME MEASURES

Introducing Extreme Measures system that dynamically adjusts the difficulty of matches. For new players struggling with their first steps, some additional game bonuses are granted after respawning to level the playing field. 

This system is based on the death streak. Every time player dies, his death streak is increased by 1. Whenever a player kills an enemy, his death streak becomes 0. Up to 4 levels of Extreme Measures grades might be applied to each player depending on his death streak values. 
Extreme Measures affect Armor, Ammo and may also apply additional HP if there are too many deaths in a row. 

Dash has never been one for half-measures: "When we enter the battlefield, it's only because we know we will win. We have to. Sometimes extreme measures are necessary."
